Can you survive the onslaught?|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Boss Rush''' is a [[Challenge Maps|challenge map]] that is only available through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It is a modified version of [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode, and while the wave structure is completely overhauled, the music, wave clear bonus, and reward multiplier reductions remain the same as in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode. Triumphing this challenge would reward the player with {{Gem|150}}, {{Exp|500}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|4}} and three [[Nuke]]s. However, these rewards cannot be obtained as this map only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Changes== ===Enemies=== Multiple enemies have their health altered, however, majority of them do not even appear in the mode. All other enemies use their default health, which is the same as the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] health. This page will use their default health for comparisons. *[[Normal Boss]] - 160 health ({{Color|No|-40}}) *[[Breaker2]] - 50 health ({{Color|Yes|+20}}) *[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] - 400 health ({{Color|No|-200}}) *[[Grave Digger]] - 10,000 health ({{Color|No|-7,500}}) *[[Abnormal]] - 6 health ({{Color|No|-2}}) *[[Quick]] - 4 health ({{Color|No|-6}}) *[[Heavy]] - 16 health ({{Color|No|-44}}) *[[Fallen]] - 180 health ({{Color|No|-45}}) *[[Fallen Hero]] - 5,000 health ({{Color|Yes|+2,000}}) *[[Fallen Guardian]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-18,000}}) *[[Fallen King]] - 75,000 health ({{Color|No|-125,000}}) ===Wave Structure=== '''Bolded ''' names indicate an enemy type's debut.

==Cash== Base cash is meant to be {{Money|900}}, though this does not happen due to a bug and is instead {{Money|500}}. The formula for calculating wave bonus between Waves 10-11 is: :{{Money|205}} + ({{Money|100}} × Waves Completed - 1) Between Waves 11-30 it is: :{{Money|205}} + ({{Money|50}} × Waves Completed - 1) Wave clear bonus and reward multipliers applied are the same as [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' **'''Boss Rush''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Shock]]s are invisible and cannot be targeted by towers. **{{Bug}} [[Molten Boss]] is invisible and cannot be targeted by towers. **{{Bug}} Wave 20 never ends unless the player is willing to wait out the extremely long timer. {{ChallengeNavBox}}
